title: CraftersMC Navigators
des: CraftersMC Navigators, looking for a navigator who can guide you at every part of your CraftersMC journey? Have a glance—you’ve come to the perfect place.
data: CraftersMC Navigators is one of the non-official CraftersMC projects. It provides users with various tools like calculators, bazaar utilities, CraftersMC AI, farming contest predictors, and a visually appealing homepage. It is one of the best-looking websites on CraftersMC and is owned by C69P2W Dev and Ndr.

title: CraftersMC Founders
des: CraftersMC owners or founders are iphyruss and irreleventdev.
data: Iphyruss and irreleventdev are the founders of CraftersMC. Irreleventdev is a software engineer. Iphyruss's birthday is on 26th March, and irreleventdev's birthday is on 12th October.

title: CraftersMC Calculators - by CraftersMC Navigators
des: A collection of tools including farm yield optimization, Slayer XP tracking, Farming Fortune stats, minion production efficiency, armor scaling, weapon scaling, and more.
data: CraftersMC Navigators offers a wide range of useful calculators and tools designed to help players optimize their gameplay, including Farm Production, Slayer XP tracking, Farming Fortune calculation, Minion Production and Manufacturing, gear stat tools like Emerald Armor, Blaze Armor, Emerald Blade, Raider Axe, Reaper Armor, Mastiff/Permafrost Armor, and Atoned Helmet. It also includes Trial of Fire survival calculations, Pet Experience tracking, Experience Level requirements, Skill Average and Skill Level calculators, Magic Find optimization, and Blood God Crest strength scaling tools.
